resolved_findings.finding: Initial verifier maps any execute bit to native Git mode and accepts noncanonical 0600/0744 filesystem permissions.
resolved_findings.resolution: Amended verifier compares stat.S_IMODE exactly with 0644 or 0755.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial verifier omits index equality; initial helpers omit a final staged-tree check. A staged path absent from the reviewed ref or an index change during capture can evade the receipt.
resolved_findings.resolution: Verifier compares target tree with write-tree at start and end; description helper checks write-tree again before output.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial helpers return symbolic requested refs and verifier resolves receipt tree again after reading a potentially different symbolic target.
resolved_findings.resolution: Parent, baseline and target are resolved once to immutable object identities; tree reads and receipt use those captured identities.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial exists()+write_text() can follow a dangling output symlink or lose a race to another writer.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both amended helpers open the output in exclusive x mode; existing and dangling-symlink controls are refused.
